source_text: Gratia Dei per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum. Igitur ego ipse mente servio legi Dei, carne autem legi peccati. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. Therefore I myself with the mind serve the law of God, but with the flesh the law of sin. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! >> Bible:Romans 7:25]]. With the mind I serve God’s law; with the flesh, sin’s. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
